# 02b Finish the path-drawn shapes: the corpus, the DOM, and the unverified half

> **Why this ticket exists, stated plainly.** Ticket 02's worker died mid-run after writing
> production code that is green but whose red-green evidence is unrecoverable — the transcript is
> gone. The repo owner chose to keep the code and verify it independently rather than rebuild it,
> which is what this ticket does. Treat every claim about the existing code as **unverified until
> your own tests pin it**.

## What is already on disk (verified by the integrator, not by its author)

- Six shapes parse and draw as `<path>`: hexagon, parallelogram, parallelogram-alt, trapezoid,
  trapezoid-alt, asymmetric. `tsc` clean, 345 focused tests green.
- `renderToSVG.test.ts` asserts the two parallelograms lean opposite ways and the two trapezoids
  too.
- Board 4's `UNIMPLEMENTED_BRACKET_FORMS` lost four rows; cylinder, subroutine and the Markdown
  label remain, which is correct — those belong to tickets 03 and 04.
- Ticket 01's carried `{}` splitter gap is fixed: `A{a-->b}` parses.

## What is missing

- **The corpus**, which is the entire point of the board it reports to. Ten `fc-shape-*` rows are
  still `rejected`; six of them now draw.
- **End-to-end tests.** `index.test.ts` is untouched, so nothing pins that these shapes survive
  `render()` — styleable, animatable, and drawn.
- **Any evidence at all** for the asymmetric shape's direction, which ticket 02 required to be
  measured with the probe rather than recalled.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] **Verify the asymmetric shape's direction against Mermaid** with
      `pnpm --filter @siren/core probe`. The dead worker may have measured it; you cannot know, so
      measure it yourself. If the drawn shape disagrees with Mermaid, fix the shape and say so —
      that is the finding this ticket exists to be able to make.
- [x] Each of the six draws, takes an author style, and animates — asserted end to end through
      `render()`, not only at the renderer seam. `style A fill:#f00` must land on the `<path>`, and
      `data-siren-id` plus the animation classes must stay on the `<g>`.
- [x] Six corpus rows move `rejected` → `supported`, each asserting **the drawn outline**, not the
      `data-siren-shape` attribute. Ticket 01 established the pattern and proved it bites by
      reverting the drawing while leaving the attribute in place; do the same check on at least one
      of yours and report it.
- [x] `A{a-->b}` gets a corpus row. It is valid Mermaid, it now works, and the gap that made it
      fail was found by ticket 01 and fixed by ticket 02 with nothing recording either.
- [x] The ratchet literal moves to whatever the suite produces. Expected `REJECTED` **32 → 25**
      (six shapes plus the brace-splitter row). **This is an expectation, not a quota** — if your
      measurement differs, your measurement wins and you say why. `SILENTLY_WRONG` stays at **3**;
      its three rows are not this board's.
- [x] **Do the six shapes emit any `siren-*` class the rect path does not?** Say so explicitly.
      `theme/default.test.ts`'s coverage fixture draws only rectangles, so a new class would ship
      unthemed without failing anything. If they emit none, say that; if they emit one, widen the
      fixture.
- [x] Every existing test still passes unedited. You are adding verification to code that is
      already green; a test of yours that fails is a real finding about the inherited code, and
      **you should report it rather than adjusting your test to match**.

## Status

reverted mutations, 1 measurement). 732 core tests / 29 board, tsc clean both.
